description.zh:
分类名称。
- 最多支持64个字节。
- UTF-8编码。
description.en:
The category name.

- The value can be up to 64 bytes in length.

- The value must be encoded in UTF-8.
The ID of the parent category.

description.zh:
分类类型。取值：
- default（默认值）：音视频/图片分类。                                 
- material：短视频素材分类。
description.en:
The type of the category. Valid values:

- default: audio, video, and image files. This is the default value.

- material: short video materials.

descriptions.zh: 分类最多支持三级分类，每级分类最多支持创建100个子分类
descriptions.en: You can create at most three levels of categories. Each category level can contain a maximum of 100 subcategories.
